name: zclass_node_mask_extra_flags_recursive
description: zClass_Node::MaskExtraFlagsRecursive applies an auxFlags mask to a node and each listB descendant.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the fastcall self/mask ABI, auxFlags &= mask at offset 0x28, signed listCountB loop at offset 0x5c, listB child recursion through offset 0x60, and no non-recursive callees.

The native smoke checks recursive masking across root, child, and grandchild nodes, plus the signed non-positive listCountB no-recursion case, alongside the adjacent extra-flag recursive helper behavior.
No VC manifest covers 0x421d60 yet; tier S verification is deferred to a zClass/Class.c source-cluster pass.
